# General Settings
### Library loading
```{r library,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(Biostrings)
library(stringr)
```
### versatile user functions
The [qw](https://ja.coder.work/so/r/240447) function in Perl.  
The [createEmptyDf](https://htsuda.net/archives/2560) function.
```{r functions}
qw <- function(...) {
  sapply(match.call()[-1], deparse)
}

createEmptyDf = function( nrow, ncol, colnames = c() ){
  data.frame( matrix( vector(), nrow, ncol, dimnames = list( c(), colnames ) ) )
}
```

# Format
```{r}
# 1. Setup metadata and directories
my_strains <- c("11", "31", "32", "38", "50", "55", "71")
# my_strains <- sprintf("%02d", seq(1, 72)) # activate this for all ECOR models

my_meta <- data.frame(
  strain = paste0("ECOR", my_strains),
  faa    = paste0("ECOR", my_strains, ".faa")
)

dir_root <- dirname(getwd())
dir_in   <- file.path(dir_root, "cds", "original")
dir_out  <- file.path(dir_root, "cds", "renamed")

# 2. Iterate through each strain for renaming
for(i in seq_len(nrow(my_meta))){
  my_st  <- my_meta$strain[i]
  path_in <- file.path(dir_in, my_meta$faa[i])
  
  # Read FASTA file
  my_aaset <- readAAStringSet(path_in)
  
  # 3. Use a tibble for cleaner string manipulation
  my_df <- tibble(full_name = names(my_aaset)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract IDs and attributes using tidyr/stringr
      old_id   = str_extract(full_name, "^\\S+"),
      atrb     = str_remove(full_name, paste0("^", old_id, "\\s+")) %>% 
                 str_remove(" \\[Escherichia coli\\]"),
      
      # Generate new IDs: ECORXX_cds_0001
      new_id   = sprintf("%s_cds_%04d", my_st, row_number()),
      
      # Construct standardized header
      new_header = sprintf("%s cds_id=%s;old_id=%s;old_atrb=%s;strain=%s",
                           new_id, new_id, old_id, atrb, my_st)
    )
  
  # 4. Check for ID uniqueness and forbidden characters (;)
  if (n_distinct(my_df$old_id) == nrow(my_df) && !any(str_detect(my_df$atrb, ";"))) {
    
    names(my_aaset) <- my_df$new_header
    
    # Save the renamed FASTA
    path_out <- file.path(dir_out, my_meta$faa[i])
    max_len <- max(width(my_aaset))
    writeXStringSet(my_aaset, filepath = path_out, format = "fasta", width = max_len + 1)
  }
}
```
